approval_scope: CPU implementation, source/configuration provenance and fail-closed measurement gates. This does not approve4K DFlash resource admission or establish any speed superiority.

resolved_findings.problem: Formal selection originally trusted claimed selected IDs without binding actual dev raw, settings, corpus, admitted lengths or source.
resolved_findings.resolution: Recompute selection from immutable private raw plus public summary SHA; bind all formal tuning groups including baseline oMLX, full flags/guard/chunk/draft identity, manifest/context/resource policy and unchanged source/environment. A bridge note cannot bypass drift. Missing portable binding disables target.

resolved_findings.problem: Resource eligibility accepted incomplete request sample inventories; preflight initially trusted a candidate label rather than effective settings and completion.
resolved_findings.resolution: Exactly one outside-timing sample per scored request and complete lifecycle are mandatory; preflight requires actual completed no-fallback Q4/group64/B5/full execution, matching guard tier,4204+256 task geometry, no swap growth and headroom. All real negative probes stay rejected.

resolved_findings.problem: Aliasing dev paths could prevent legitimate formal preparation, expose private paths or invalidate public coherence digests.
resolved_findings.resolution: Private raw plus sanitized summary with raw SHA; selection uses stable path-free identity fields. Exact raw/summary aliases and recomputed public coherence digest preserve private execution bytes. Negative controls cover drift and public transformation.

code_review_checks: Ordinary oMLX performance wrapper invokes the official0.7.1 CLI without diagnostic monkeypatch flags.
Only bounded Q4/group64 block4/5 adaptive/full candidates plus default baseline enter the oMLX dev tuning group; stronger valid winners cannot be dropped before heldout.
Exact trained checkpoint pin, complete file SHA checks and official quantization/load/attach/verify log evidence prevent silent baseline fallback.
Source archive/member map, actual frozen helper/import paths, commands/cwd/PYTHONPATH, settings/draft/resource/dev evidence and interpreter bytes are bound and rechecked outside timing.
Complete inventory and balanced heldout order remain necessary for target flags; dev selection cannot become a competitive result.
